summary: Service account SAML cert rotation prevents scripted logins and blocks Vault/Secrets access for infra pipelines
description:
Issue summary:
Service account SAML certificate (svc-infra-builds@redwood) was rotated via automated secret rotation job on 2026-03-12. After rotation, several CI pipelines and the infra secrets sync task began receiving SAML assertion failures and could not authenticate to internal console or vault.

Impact:
- 7 active CI pipelines across infra and ml-platform failed to fetch secrets causing build/test stages to abort. Estimated 45 minutes of developer velocity lost across teams.
- Internal secrets sync job failed to update downstream caches, risking stale secrets for running services.
- No external customer impact, internal-only, but blocking deploys for a few mid-priority services.

Environment:
- Affected: prod / us-east-1 service accounts and pipelines that use SAML assertion for SSO-to-service-account flow.
- Okta tenant: redwood-prod.okta.com
- Vault cluster: vault-prod-001 (consul backend)

Steps to reproduce:
1. Triggered rotation of svc-infra-builds SAML cert via rotation job (rotations/2026-03-12).
2. Pipelines attempt SSO exchange using updated cert; Okta returns 401 SAML Assertion Error.
3. Vault auth plugin rejects assertion; pipelines fail at secret fetch step.

Logs and errors:
- Okta logs: SAML assertion invalid: 'Issuer not recognized' for svc-infra-builds (timestamp 2026-03-12T03:04:12Z) — see Okta log ID: okta-log-20260312-0042.
- Vault logs: 'auth.saml: assertion validation failed: unknown issuer' (vault-prod-001 / var/log/vault.log).
- CI logs: 'ERROR: failed to fetch secrets: SAML auth failed (status 401)'.

Additional context:
- Rotation job used new certificate thumbprint but the Okta application that accepts the service account assertion (app id: app-ops-service-assertion) still referenced the old SP metadata. The rotation pipeline updates cert in secret store but does not automatically update SP metadata in Okta.
- Related recent change: IAM automation (PR #1220) updated rotation job to split cert and metadata updates into two steps but did not include automatic Okta application update.
comments: 2026-03-12 09:20 - Support (Mira Chen): Received reports from infra team that multiple pipelines failed after scheduled cert rotation. Escalating to IAM.

2026-03-12 10:05 - IAM (Daniel Park): Confirmed SAML assertion errors in Okta logs for svc-infra-builds. Manually validated new cert present in secretstore but Okta app metadata still references old certificate fingerprint.
2026-03-12 10:37 - Infra (Lena Ortiz): Temporarily re-run pipelines with cached tokens; some succeeded but not all. Requesting a manual hotfix as we have blocked deploys.

2026-03-12 11:15 - Support (Mira Chen): Applied manual workaround: re-uploaded SP metadata for app-ops-service-assertion with new cert thumbprint in Okta; restarted affected jobs. Observed pipeline success for 5/7 jobs. Opening follow-up for automation fix.

2026-03-13 08:54 - IAM (Daniel Park): Adding investigation notes and proposed remedial action: make rotation job also call Okta API to update app metadata atomically, and add pre-rotation validation step to ensure Okta app accepts new cert.
2026-03-14 14:02 - Platform Eng (Rohit Singh): Created PR to rotation job (infra/rotation: PR#1254) to include Okta app update and guardrail checks. Planning canary rollout next week.
investigation_notes:
Hypothesis: Rotation job updated certificate in secretstore but did not update SAML SP metadata in Okta, causing issuer mismatch. Verified Okta app configuration had old cert fingerprint. Cross-checked rotation logs (rotations/2026-03-12) and IAM automation PR #1220 which split cert and metadata updates. No evidence of Okta API errors during rotation as the step to call Okta was absent. Impacted tokens were short-lived; manual re-upload restored functionality for most pipelines.
Action items identified: 1) Patch rotation job to perform atomic update of cert+Okta SP metadata, 2) Add pre-rotation Okta verification, 3) Add post-rotation smoke tests for pipelines, 4) Add monitoring alert for SAML assertion spike.
resolution: Workaround implemented: manual SP metadata update in Okta for app-ops-service-assertion (performed 2026-03-12 11:10 UTC) restored access for most pipelines. Permanent fix: PR#1254 (infra/rotation) adds Okta app metadata update and validation; staged canary scheduled 2026-03-20. Follow-ups: add unit/integration tests for rotation flow and runbook updated at confluence: 'Rotations — service account SAML'. No further user-facing action required; ticket will remain open until canary completes and runbook updated.
